text:
Rina: Putting up a preflight for the "compact-prompting" change (service: rn-compose) — targeting 2026-07-04 05:00 UTC. Draft RN: https://internal/redwood/rn/compact-prompting-2026-07-04.md. Need pin owner, rollback owner, and internal blurb author.

Owen: I can take pinning. Plan to stage image rn-compose:v3.2.0-q6 at 04:30 UTC and run canary in us-east first.

Camila: Ops recommends 15m canary us-east, 10m eu-west. Stop rollout if p95 > baseline*1.3 or 5xxs > 1% sustained for 3m. Fallback: rn-compose:v3.1.7. I'll add the runbook and thresholds to the RN.

Rina: RN edits before blast: add explicit rollback command, contact list (oncall + eng-sre + product), and a line about token impact (approx -0.25 tok/op). Also request a 1-line internal blurb for quick posting.

Owen: Adding rollback snippet here:
```
# rollback
/deploy rn-compose --image=rn-compose:v3.1.7 --env=prod --force --reason="rollback: perf or errors"
```

Camila: Ops triggers restated: immediate rollback if 5xx > 1% for 3m or p95 > baseline by 30% over a 5m window. I'll author ops-runbooks/rn-compose-canary.md and link it.

Rina: Who will post internal annoucements? Need a post to #eng and #customer-success 10 minutes after we hit full rollout. Also embargo external comms for 30m post-rollout to let metrics settle.

Leo: I can write the internal blurb and post to #eng. Sam (or whoever owns support) should post to #customer-success with an impact sentence.

QA-Bot: Preflight smoke checklist created: GET /_health, POST /v1/compose with "smoke" prompt asserting tokens < 130 and latency < 500ms. Add these to the deploy pipeline.

DeployBot: deploy queued rn-compose image v3.2.0-q6 -> staging. Use:
```
/deploy rn-compose --image=rn-compose:v3.2.0-q6 --env=prod --canary=15m --pin=false
```

Owen: Staging done at 04:30 UTC. I'll kick the canary at 05:00 UTC.

DeployBot: deploy started at 1835000100 (status: canary running) — https://deployboard/redwood/1835000100

Leo: Posting internal blurb draft here: "Deploying compact-prompting to reduce token usage across compose flows. Monitoring latency & errors during canary. Contact eng-oncall for regressions." Approve?

Camila: Looks good. Add the runbook link and contact list lines.

Leo: Updated and will post to #eng 10m after full rollout.

Owen: Canary first 8m: p95 +10%, error_rate 0.4%. Smoke tests passing.

Camila: eu-west expansion started at 1835000180. One pod returned 502; autoscaler cycled it and health recovered. No sustained 5xx.

DeployBot: canary expanded to eu-west at 1835000180 (status: canary expanded).

Owen: Pinning to 60% while watching a 10m window.

DeployBot: partial pin applied at 1835000220 (pin=60%).

Camila: Observability: p95 holding within +6% baseline, errors 0.5%. Ops runbook and escalation rules active.

Owen: Rolling to 100% at 05:20 UTC if stable.

DeployBot: rollout completed at 1835000290 (status: success, rollout 100%). Summary: us-east 15m -> eu-west 10m -> staggered expansion -> 100% complete.

Rina: Great job. Leo please post the internal announcement to #eng and @Camila post to #customer-success with the impact bullet and cost delta. Remember embargo external comms for 30m.

Leo: Posting now to #eng with runbook link.

Camila: Posted to #customer-success; included runbook link, impact line, and rollback command.

Rina: Final step — update the public-facing RN with the rollback snippet and token delta before any external blast. Closing thread; if anything regresses run the rollback command and ping #eng-oncall.
